questions.questionText: What is the HCF of 15/7 and 7/2?
questions.explanation: HCF of fractions = HCF of numerators / LCM of denominators = 1 / 14 = 1/14.
LCM of fractions = LCM of numerators / HCF of denominators = 9 / 4 = 9/4.

questions.questionText: What is the HCF of 2/13 and 13/6?

questions.questionText: What is the least positive number which, when divided by 10/13, 6/13 and 7/10, gives a whole number in each case?
questions.explanation: A number N divides evenly by each fraction when N is a common multiple of them, so the least is the LCM = LCM(num)/HCF(den) = 210/1 = 210.
questions.shortcut: Least common multiple of fractions = LCM(num)/HCF(den).

questions.questionText: Three ropes are 7/9 m, 13/4 m and 5/12 m long. What is the greatest length (in metres) that can measure each of them exactly?
questions.explanation: Greatest measuring length = HCF of fractions = HCF of numerators / LCM of denominators = 1/36 = 1/36 m.
